profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | JavaScript | MERN Stack | Weightlifting
profile.summary:
I started my career as a Security Operations Analyst, serving as the first point of contact during emergencies. That role sharpened my ability to communicate under pressure, make decisions quickly, and document scenarios with precision. I later transitioned into social services, where my work centered around supporting individuals and communities, strengthening my ability to listen, understand different perspectives, and solve problems based on clients' needs. 
Throughout each stage of my career, one thing has remained consistent: my passion for people and community. Whether working behind the scenes or supporting individuals directly, I’ve always been drawn to work that allows me to make a meaningful impact. Today, as a software engineer, I bring those experiences into technology with a passion for creating accessible digital solutions.
Today, I bring those experiences into technology with a passion for building accessible digital solutions. I’m looking to partner with teams and clients building products that make a real difference — if that’s what you’re working on, let's connect.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build responsive web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js.
- Develop full-stack applications from concept through deployment, applying responsive design and version control best practices. 
- Use Git and GitHub to manage source code, branches, commits, and collaborative development workflows. 
- Collaborate with developers to build features, troubleshoot issues, review code, and solve technical challenges.

positions.title: Social Worker Tech
positions.description:
- Collaborate with social workers, supervisors, and managers to coordinate case activities and support service plans.
- Prepare and maintain confidential case documentation, referral packets, approval requests, and agency records.
- Coordinate transportation and logistical support for medical, social service, and agency-related appointments.
- Conduct and document communication with schools, law enforcement, service providers, and community partners.
- Assist with time-sensitive case needs, client transportation, service coordination, and other field-based responsibilities.
positions.insights: Assessment and Intervention, Administration and +2 skills

positions.title: Control Center Analyst
positions.description:
- Monitored security operations using CCTV, access-control, building-management, and emergency monitoring systems.
- Investigated and verified alarms, coordinated first-responder dispatch, and communicated critical incident updates to management.
- Managed multiple systems and information sources simultaneously while responding to time-sensitive operational events.
- Produced detailed incident reports, communication logs, and case documentation with a strong focus on accuracy.
positions.insights: Customer Service Operations, Closed-Circuit Television (CCTV) and +4 skills
